notes.title: [0.1.2] Early Access Day 1 Bug Fix Patch.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Bug Fix: Now players won't get stuck on the second floor of the first 3310 Puncher & Kicker level.
[/list]

[b]All users should update their client before launching the game, or it will crash.[/b]

Great thanks to Kurtiler and 󰀅▽󰀅󰀍󰀃Charley for pointing out this bug!

notes.title: [0.1.1] Pre-release bug fix patch.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Bug Fix: Key Settings Scene now will show as expected when clicking on the "Cog" icon.
[*] Bug Fix: Players will no longer get stuck in the black and white (first computer) level.
[*] Bug Fix: All stats & achievements should be triggered correctly now.
[/list]
